steps.observed: Published payload (publishedData) contains both blocks; page opens on Sites

steps.expected: Block renders with configured heading and button
steps.observed: Heading 'Reserve a table at B2' and button 'Book now at B2' render (054-block-page-fresh.png); inline block renders its compact party/date/time bar (054-sites-block-button-inline.png)

steps.action: Activate the button block
steps.expected: Lands on /reserve prefilled from the query and continues to slot selection without re-asking

Both continue to slot selection without re-asking. The default date/time shown by the inline bar are today + 19:00, so the preferred-slot check was done on today's date (2026-10-17).

assertions.title: Operator decline frees the held capacity and is visible to the guest

steps.action: Create request 2 on Sites (party 12, 2026-11-03 21:00, guest +15555552202)
steps.observed: 201, confirmation XTE6CA8Y, holds G10-T11 21:00-22:00 (058-request2-confirmation.png)

steps.action: Open Requests tab, click Decline, type a reason, confirm
steps.observed: POST .../rsv_124bdc9d.../decline -> 200 with body {locationId, reason:'No 12-top available for that time in this round'}; the row moves to 'Decided in this session - Declined' (058-requests-after-decline.png)

steps.action: curl GET /reservations/manage with request 2's manage token
steps.observed: HTTP 200, status=declined, canCancel=false, canModify=false (058-manage-after-decline.json)

steps.action: Verify the held capacity is bookable again
steps.expected: Capacity the declined request held is free
steps.observed: sqlite: its G10-T11 occupancy row flipped active=0; a new public request at the same slot was accepted (201) and the operator availability at 21:00 again lists G10-T11 as the first free table (058-capacity-release.json). Public availability for party 12 is not a slot list on this day (request mode), so the freed unit is demonstrated through the accepted new request and the operator view.

steps.action: Try to approve the declined request afterwards
steps.observed: curl POST .../approve -> 409 {"error":"invalid_status_transition"}; in the UI the declined row offers no Approve action (058-book-after-decline.png)

assertions.notes: The capacity-release reading: before the decline, operator availability at 21:00 could not pick G10-T11 (held by the pending request 2) and suggested G10-T5; after the decline it lists G10-T11 as the first free table again (its occupancy is active=0), while G10-T12 stays taken by the approved native booking.

assertions.issues: The journey passed, but a real defect surfaced while creating the second request: a public request whose planner-chosen table is held by another PENDING request fails with a raw 409 and the generic guest error (see issue-pending-hold-409.json and the frictions below). It did not lose any request or misroute any message; it blocks some request times. Reported here because it was found in this flow.
assertions.notes: The contract says 'party 12 tomorrow'; the isolation registry assigns this group the future date 2026-11-03, which was used instead. The manager alert arrived via the 120 s interval tick (also exercised manually). The notification bell also showed a plain-text fallback row rendering a raw i18n object for one older location name; noted but out of scope.

frictions.description: The website builder rendered only 1 of the 3 reservation sections stored in D1 because a stale `epic_preview_sections` cookie overrode the loader.
frictions.resolution: Cleared the cookie in the session; the builder then rendered all sections and the blocks could be configured and published.

frictions.description: The inline-layout radio in the block editor was reported as 'covered' by another element, so a ref click failed.
frictions.resolution: Clicked the [role=radio] element from in-page JS.

frictions.description: POST /reservations/requests returned 429 on the first attempt of request 2 - the durable per-IP limit (5 per 10 min) is shared with every validator on this host.
frictions.resolution: Waited ~75 s for the fixed window to roll over and retried; captured the 429 in the browser network log.

frictions.description: My owned date 2026-11-03 carries a leftover `online_closed` special day ('G5-Online Closed (edited)' from an earlier round), so public availability shows 'Online booking is closed for this date' and direct online slot bookings are impossible on that date.
frictions.resolution: Worked within the state: the request flow (host-channel planning) still works on that date; VAL-ONLINE-054's deep-link flow was demonstrated on today's date and VAL-ONLINE-059's web-side booking used the request flow.

frictions.description: Request 1 displayed the pre-existing guest 'R2Book Guest One' instead of the name typed in the form because public guest resolution reuses an existing guest by phone and never rewrites the name.
frictions.resolution: Accepted as documented behavior; used +15555552202..204 for the later guests.

frictions.description: The public request planner kept choosing tables that other PENDING requests already hold (the engine's ACTIVE_BOOKING_STATUSES omits pending_approval), so request creation collides with the rsv_occupancy_no_overlap_insert trigger and answers a raw 409.
frictions.resolution: Submitted requests at times whose planner-chosen table was free (21:00 instead of 20:00). The defect itself is reported as an issue, not worked around silently.

frictions.description: agent-browser screenshots given a relative path land in the session's working directory (the repo root), not the evidence directory.
frictions.resolution: Moved each screenshot into {missionDir}/evidence/guest-channels-and-crm/b2-requests-block/ right after capture.

frictions.description: The manage link extracted from the page needed JSON-string parsing before use; the first token parse kept quoting characters and GET /reservations/manage answered 404.
frictions.resolution: Parsed the JSON string properly, then the token worked (HTTP 200).

summary: Tested 5 assertions: 5 passed. VAL-ONLINE-054 (block renders; button and inline deep-links prefill and auto-search; preferred slot highlighted; config/availability 200; no console errors), VAL-ONLINE-057 (request row shows guest/party/time/contact; approve -> 200; manage view booked at 19:30), VAL-ONLINE-058 (decline with reason -> 200; declined row; manage view declined; re-approve 409; capacity released - occupancy inactive and a new request accepted at the same slot), VAL-ONLINE-059 (detail sheet shows Online/Web vs Mobile app/iOS app with matching channel=online/client=web and native/ios), VAL-CROSS-012 (request_received/approved/declined emails captured; manager alert with location+count only, no PII; notify route 200/401/400/idempotent; booking in Book at 19:30 with party 12; declined request produces no booking). One real defect found and reported: public request creation can fail with a raw 409 when its planner-chosen table is held by another pending request (engine ACTIVE_BOOKING_STATUSES omits pending_approval while the DB trigger rejects the overlap). Frictions: shared-IP 429 on requests (waited ~75 s), leftover online_closed special day on the owned date, stale builder cookie, covered inline-radio click. No blockers.
